text:
We have a NEW location for our Halloween Meetup! 🎃🐾

We're excited to announce that we'll now be hosting our event at @otherhalfphilly 🍻

Even better, Other Half will be hosting its Fall Festival that day, featuring vendors, live music, and plenty of fall fun! It's going to be a great afternoon for both our two-legged and four-legged friends!

Saturday, October 24th
12–2 PM
Other Half Brewing: 1002 Canal St, Philadelphia, PA 19123

Don't forget to dress up your pups (and yourselves!) for our 
Halloween costume contests and prizes!

Thank you all for your patience and understanding as I worked to secure a new location. I'm incredibly grateful to Other Half Brewing for welcoming our group, especially on such short notice!
